title: RBAC v2 steward handbook: control-plane audit play and SAML troubleshooting macros
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a practical, single-page 'steward handbook' for on-call and support engineers that consolidates RBAC v2 control-plane procedures, high-signal audit queries, SAML/SSO failure triage steps, and a small set of reusable support macros. This is intended to reduce time-to-resolution for access incidents, standardize escalation, and provide run-ready commands and links that non-security engineers can safely execute. Scope excludes changes to RBAC policies themselves; this is documentation and tooling for operators and support (incl. read-only audit queries and safe remediation steps).
acceptance_criteria: One-page steward handbook published in Confluence with versioned link and table of contents
At least 6 support macros created and validated in sandbox; macros documented with expected outputs and rollback steps
Audit query templates for common workflows (grant/revoke, failed SAML assertion, token misuse) added with example outputs
SAML trace checklist with precise fields to collect and a diagnostic script for assertion inspection
Peer review from Security Eng and Support (signoffs captured in comments)
On-call play executed once in dry-run and feedback integrated
deliverables: Confluence: 'RBAC v2 steward handbook' (single-page canonical doc)
Support macros: 6 shell/gh/console macros with examples and safety notes
Audit templates: 4 saved Athena/BigQuery queries and example result sets
SAML troubleshooting checklist and a small python script 'saml-inspect.py' for assertion parsing
Escalation matrix and contact card for security on-call

macros: macro:sso:fetch-assertion --request-id <id> --save /tmp/assertion-base64.txt  # decodes base64 assertion for inspection
macro:sso:inspect-assertion python3 saml-inspect.py /tmp/assertion-base64.txt  # prints issuer, audience, attrs
macro:rbac:temp-grant --user <email> --role <role_id> --expires-in 1h --tag <ticket>  # creates short-lived access; requires manual approval step in doc
macro:rbac:revoke-temp --grant-id <id>  # immediate revoke of temp grants; documents required audit fields
